description: Pattern: the board-design turn of the briefing on REAL material. Twelve entries of the decision loop's own ledger (EG-Desk only), two topics interleaved in time, every entry longer than the 90 characters of a sequence line. The engine reads them, writes the progress answer, and after it is posted the check runs the briefing flow (the production Board/Decisions handler, the Decision model, the engine's private fresh-thread turns writing the fill). Expectations, derived by code from the entries: the board is presented, every key fact (commit id, count or measurement, as the ledger writes it) is in the text of the published cards, and within each topic the facts are in time order. Two conversations: EGDESK_BRIEFING_OUTPUT_SCHEMA on and off. Runs only with --decisions. Version 2 hands the notes to the answering turn (EGDESK_BRIEFING_HAND_MATERIALS=on, default off in every other script) instead of letting the engine read the folder with tool rounds: one conversation, schema on. Version 3 also sets EGDESK_BRIEFING_LAYERS=on (default off in every other script). Version 4 also sets EGDESK_BRIEFING_PREFILL=on (default off in every other script).

turns.say: ledger 폴더의 기록을 읽고 두 흐름(통합 게이트, 실호출 측정)을 각각 날짜와 시간 순서로 정리해줘. 항목마다 커밋 id나 건수·측정값을 기록에 적힌 그대로 같이 적어줘. 파일은 바꾸지 마.
